originalTitle: MLS investigates reports of antisemitic chants toward New England’s Dor Turgeman in Montreal
summary: The Israel international scored and gestured toward CF Montéal fans, with the Revolution later saying the ‘strongly condemn’ the chants
content: The New England Revolution have denounced chants they deemed “antisemitic” and “discriminatory” from CF Montréal fans during Saturday’s MLS matchup between the sides in Quebec. The specific chants were directed towards New England’s Israeli striker Dor Turgeman, with broadcast microphones capturing fans chanting “free Palestine” shortly before he scored a goal. MLS on Monday confirmed it was “aware of reported antisemitic and discriminatory language directed at a New England Revolution player” and that the matter is under investigation. “The Revolution strongly condemn the antisemitic and discriminatory abuse directed at forward Dor Turgeman by CF Montreal supporters during Saturday’s away match,” the club said in a statement issued Monday afternoon. “The club immediately reported the incident to Major League Soccer and has fully supported the investigation. We appreciate MLS’ swift response and commitment to addressing incidents of discrimination. We are hopeful that those responsible will be held accountable for their unacceptable actions.” The scenes in Montreal garnered attention in part due to Turgeman’s response. In the 36th minute, Turgeman scored a tap-in finish to put New England up 2-0. The 22-year-old, who signed for the Revolution last year, stood in front of the home supporters bank with outstretched arms as fans jeered and gestured. Turgeman followed the stance by raising a hand to his ear and walking from end to end of the section with the goal in between him and the crowd. The match ended in a 2-2 draw. In a statement on Sunday, Montréal said the club would investigate the scenes at Stade Saputo. “The club does not tolerate discrimination, or hateful behavior of any kind,” the statement read. “We take these allegations very seriously and are currently reviewing the matter. We are in contact with MLS and the New England Revolution as we work to establish all the facts and take the necessary actions.” After the Hamas attack on Israel in October 2023, MLS banned both Israeli and Palestinian flags from its venues, with exemptions given in the case of an Israeli or Palestinian player’s presence on a roster. Columbus Crew supporters, for example, were able to display the Palestinian flag after signing Palestine international Wessam Abou Ali in August 2025, but the leaguewide ban remains intact. In February 2025, the league condemned Los Angeles FC investor Ruben Gnanalingam for alleged anti-Israel posts shared on LinkedIn. The Malaysian investor apologized and still retains his stake in the club.
chineseTitle: MLS 调查蒙特利尔针对新英格兰队多尔·图格曼 (Dor Turgeman) 的反犹太口号的报道
chineseSummary: 这位以色列国脚进球并向蒙特利尔球迷做出手势，革命队随后表示“强烈谴责”这些口号
chineseContent: 新英格兰革命谴责了蒙特利尔队球迷在周六魁北克举行的美国职业足球大联盟(MLS)比赛期间发出的口号，他们认为这是“反犹太主义”和“歧视性”的。这些特定的口号是针对新英格兰队的以色列前锋多尔·图格曼（Dor Turgeman）的，广播麦克风捕捉到球迷在他进球前不久高呼“自由巴勒斯坦”的声音。美国职业足球大联盟周一证实，它“意识到针对新英格兰革命球员的反犹太主义和歧视性语言的报道”，并且此事正在接受调查。该俱乐部在周一下午发布的一份声明中表示：“革命队强烈谴责蒙特利尔队球迷在周六客场比赛期间针对前锋多尔·图格曼的反犹太主义和歧视性虐待行为。” “俱乐部立即向美国职业足球大联盟报告了这一事件，并全力支持调查。我们赞赏美国职业足球大联盟的迅速反应和对解决歧视事件的承诺。我们希望那些责任者能够为其不可接受的行为承担责任。”蒙特利尔的场景引起了人们的关注，部分原因是图格曼的回应。第36分钟，图格曼补射破门，新英格兰队2-0领先。这位去年与革命队签约的22岁球员，站在主场球迷银行前，张开双臂，遭到球迷的嘲笑和手势。图格曼遵循这一立场，将一只手举到耳边，从该区域的一端走到另一端，球门位于他和人群之间。比赛最终双方2-2战平。蒙特利尔在周日的一份声明中表示，俱乐部将调查萨普托体育场的场景。声明中写道：“俱乐部不容忍任何形式的歧视或仇恨行为。” “我们非常严肃地对待这些指控，目前正在重新调查
